title: The Cold Static Revisited
author: Ansel Pemberton
blurb: Sebastian Delacroix, the last human technician on an automated relay station, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
